<!--
Title: a Conventional Commits title; maintainers add the review bracket at the
end, for example `feat(ui): add a search field [15m ?]`. `[15m]` is the
estimated review time, `?` marks a product decision, `after #N` a real
dependency. A breaking change carries `!` before the colon.

Body: under 200 words, bold markers, no headings, no checklists, no tables.
Delete the optional markers you do not use.
-->

**Symptom:** what observably goes wrong, with place and number. For a feature,
use **Gap:** and say what is missing.

**Change:** what the change does, and the parts it touches.

**Out of scope:** optional.

**Size:** optional, only where the line count misleads.

**Verified:** how and where it was checked.

Closes #
